en.headline: New companies in {region} that still need an accountant
en.subheadline: Every week {firma} gets a short list of businesses registered around {ort} in the last few weeks – before they have picked an accountant or payroll provider. Each lead is dated and links to the official register.

signals.title: Registered in the last weeks
signals.text: New directors choose their accountant early – often before the first VAT, payroll or year-end deadline. Reaching them in week one beats reaching them in month six.

signals.title: Hiring for finance roles
signals.text: Local employers with a bookkeeping or payroll vacancy open for weeks are a natural conversation about outsourcing.

signals.title: Checked and sourced
signals.text: Every lead shows the company, registration date, address and the Companies House record, so {firma} can verify it before calling.

faq.a: Only companies in the areas you choose – for example {region} – with a fresh, dated event that gives you a reason to get in touch. Each lead is delivered to you once.

faq.q: Where does the data come from?
faq.a: Official company registers, official announcements and companies' own careers pages. We do not use LinkedIn, job boards or other platforms whose terms forbid it.

faq.q: Is there personal data in the leads?
faq.a: No. Company data only: name, address, website, main phone number where published, the event and its source.

faq.q: How does this fit an accountancy practice?
faq.a: Most practices win new clients by being first to a new director. We do the watching; your team gets a ready list with a reason to call and a suggested opening line.

faq.q: What does the free sample include?
faq.a: 10 current leads from {region}, with the same fields as the weekly delivery. No obligation, no card required.
